steps: Lease service grants holder an expiry and monotonically increasing epoch E.
Holder renews before T while it remains healthy.
Every protected operation carries E and the resource rejects older epochs.
After expiry, a new holder receives a higher epoch without accepting stale writes.

lesson.scenario: Two schedulers contend for a partition lease while fencing tokens prevent an expired owner from writing.

steps.title: Acquire a bounded lease
steps.narration: Lease Store grants Scheduler A epoch 81 until server time 13:04:15Z.

workerB.detail: No work accepted in this phase

target.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: A has temporary ownership plus a monotonic fence.
steps.invariant: Lease expiry is decided by the lease authority, and every protected write carries a monotonic fencing token checked by the resource.

steps.title: Write with the fence
steps.narration: Partition 12 accepts epoch 81 because it is not below the highest observed epoch.

workerB.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: Lease belief is enforced at the resource.
steps.invariant: Lease expiry is decided by the lease authority, and every protected write carries a monotonic fencing token checked by the resource.

steps.title: Miss renewal during a pause
steps.narration: A 42-second process pause causes renewal after 13:04:15Z, so the store rejects epoch 81.

workerB.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: A no longer owns the lease even if its local clock disagrees.
steps.invariant: Lease expiry is decided by the lease authority, and every protected write carries a monotonic fencing token checked by the resource.

steps.title: Grant a higher epoch
steps.narration: Scheduler B acquires the expired lease and receives epoch 82 until 13:04:48Z.
steps.outcome: Ownership moves with a monotonic token.
steps.invariant: Lease expiry is decided by the lease authority, and every protected write carries a monotonic fencing token checked by the resource.

steps.title: Fence the stale owner
steps.narration: Partition 12 rejects A because 81 is below highest epoch 82, then accepts B checkpoint 1001.
steps.outcome: Overlapping beliefs cannot create stale writes.
steps.invariant: Lease expiry is decided by the lease authority, and every protected write carries a monotonic fencing token checked by the resource.

production.scenario: GitHub Actions assigns queued jobs to self-hosted runners with expiring ownership so stale dispatchers cannot double-start work.
components: durable queue of workflow jobs waiting for eligible self-hosted runner capacity
service boundary that matches jobs to runners and returns dispatch payloads
control-plane service that grants and renews runner assignment intervals
durable authority in PostgreSQL for lease owner, generation, and expiry metadata
execute admitted workflow jobs only while their assignment remains valid
control path that expires dead owners and requeues stranded workflow jobs
observability path for expired leases, duplicate starts, and renewal latency
flows: The dispatch boundary pulls the next eligible workflow job from the durable queue before work can start.
The boundary requests a lease for one job and one runner before returning the assignment.
The lease service records the owner, generation, and expiry in the authoritative ledger.
Runner agents start work only after receiving an active lease-backed assignment token.
The janitor forces expiration when heartbeat or renewal safety margins are missed.
The authoritative ledger exposes expired job records that must be requeued for execution.
Operations teams watch renewal latency, forced expirations, and duplicate-start avoidance.
